scope_note: These are controlled names for repository narrative and the identified historical/procedural contexts. Historical official sources do not by themselves establish a company's present-day status.
rules: Resolve an acronym through this register before expanding it.
Do not translate, paraphrase or invent a legal entity's registered or procedural name.
Use the first_reference form on first narrative mention and the acronym thereafter.
Preserve a different source spelling or entity-form suffix only when it is clearly labelled as a source literal.
Do not merge a company, former name, shareholder, client, payer or represented party without a separate source bridge.

records.name_continuity_rule: Aweswell Limited and Monterecco Sun Park Limited are the same UK company under company number 07716847; use the name applicable to the source date.

official_sources.proposition: The register identifies AWESWELL LIMITED, company number 07716847, and lists MONTERECCO SUN PARK LIMITED as its previous name through 3 June 2014.

records.name_continuity_rule: Pink Canary Services, S.L.U. and the former Spanish name Monterecco Sun Park, S.L.U. refer to the same Spanish legal person under NIF B76564517. Use the name applicable to the source date. Do not infer the exact change date until the registry act is obtained.
records.separation_rule: Never conflate this Spanish company with UK company 07716847, formerly Monterecco Sun Park Limited and now Aweswell Limited.

official_sources.proposition: The registry publication records incorporation of MONTERECCO SUN PARK SL, declaration of unipersonality and sheet TF 49739.

official_sources.authority: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado
official_sources.proposition: The 2019 notice identifies PINK CANARY SERVICES SLU., NIF B76564517, in the Tenerife registry. The recorded NIF-revocation agreement is not evidence of corporate extinction.
